character_identity.name: Professor Torque
character_identity.identity_summary: Friendly Sikh male professor and master mechanic, tall lean adult male proportions, deep crimson/magenta Dastar turban with black center undercap, dark rectangular glasses, expressive dark eyebrows, neatly shaped black jawline beard and upward-curled handlebar moustache, olive-green tailored suit, white shirt, navy tie with thin diagonal red-orange and cream/white stripes, dark navy pocket square, brown leather belt, watch on left wrist with brown strap, brown lace-up leather dress shoes.

sheet_panels: Hero full-body 3/4 standing view (arms crossed, workshop backdrop with TinyTorque branding)
Upper-mid panel: Pointing upward (right index raised, enthusiastic open smile)
Upper-right panel: Adjusting glasses (right hand at lower-left rim, teasing smirk, pupils partially visible)
Middle-center panel: Open-hand explanation (both palms open forward, animated speaking expression)
Middle-right panel: Thoughtful chin-rest (left arm folded supporting right elbow, fingers at chin)
Lower-center panel: Celebratory fist (right fist raised, wide grin, squinted cheerful eyes)
Lower-right panel: Back standing view (hands on hips, rear suit seam and trouser silhouette)

proportions_relative.measurement_basis: Pixel landmark ratios observed on hero full-body standing 3/4 panel (not orthographic metric scale)
silhouette_rules: Maintain tall, lean adult male proportions (~7.3 bare-head / ~6.15 turbaned-head ratio).
Do NOT widen torso or add muscular bulk.
Do NOT shorten legs below ~50% of bare-head stature.
Preserve crisp tailored wool jacket shoulder line and slim flat-front trouser taper.
Preserve Dastar crown volume rising cleanly above forehead hairline without dwarfing face.

Sideways pointer toward adjacent 3D mechanical cutaway without crossing into machinery
Rotational finger-circle gesture illustrating turbine/airflow spin

topology_standards: All-quad SubD-ready topology (no stray n-gons or poles in facial deformation loops).
Concentric circular edge loops around orbicularis oculi, nasolabial fold, and orbicularis oris (avoid mouth distortion under beard).
Turban modeled as overlapping sculpted/retopoed layered cloth strips over locked cranial volume so head turns never expose bald/scalp gaps.
Beard & handlebar moustache built with clean sculpted base cage locked to jaw/lip skin-wrap drivers plus layered stylized hair cards/clumps.
Suit jacket sleeves and shoulders engineered with clean deltoid bend loops and hidden shoulder-pad proxy bones to prevent lapel collapse during pointing/crossed-arm poses.
Separate shirt collar, knot-locked tie mesh, and trouser hems with clean shoe tongue-to-sock boundary.

body_rig: IK/FK switchable arms and legs with pole targets and clean knee/elbow pin locks.
Clavicle auto-follow drivers for overhead pointing and fist-raise.
Spine FK + spline stretch-lite (minimal) to keep suit hem crisp.
Dedicated jacket-skirt / lapel / tie / pocket-square helper bones with collision constraints against chest/arms (crucial for Arms-Crossed and Chin-Rest poses).
Glasses parented to head-bridge socket with an explicit Hand-Grab space switch for Adjusting Glasses.
Turban bone pinned to head-top with subtle secondary micro-jiggle disabled by default for crisp mechanical authority.
facial_rig: Hybrid FACS + Corrective Shape Keys + Bone-driven Jaw/Eyelids/Brows.
Synchronized beard/moustache corrective shapes tied directly to jawDrop, mouthSmile, mouthFunnel, and pucker so beard never detaches or clips chin.
Dual eye-aim target + per-eye eyelid fleshy-follow drivers + clean blink closure.

performance_rules: Align jaw/viseme timings to TinyTorque dynamic speech tiers (140-170 WPM) without chattering jaw micro-oscillations.
Preserve moustache curl silhouette cleanly during wide EE and rounded OO shapes.
Co-articulate brows and head micro-accents on stressed keywords defined in Segment Directorial Metadata.

educational_framing_rules: Machine-as-Hero remains primary in mechanical closeups; Professor Torque serves as guide alongside cutaway/bench or in clean PIP/split framing.
Do not allow character silhouette or gestures to occlude active airflow arrows, rotor spin, or bearing cross-sections.
Maintain TINYTORQUE_STYLIZED_3D_CARTOON_V1 shader lighting consistency (3600K key / 5600K rim) between character and machinery.
tinytorque_integration_plan.deployment_gate_prerequisite: Do NOT activate automated Professor Torque Flow video generation until renderer remediation & Omni-Flash pipeline validation pass independently and Human Owner signs off on open design decisions.

consistency_validation_checklist: 1. Silhouette & ~7.3 bare-head (~6.15 turbaned-head) tall lean adult proportion preserved across camera lenses.
2. Deep crimson/magenta Dastar fold count/V-angle and black patka forehead triangle consistent front/side/back.
3. Dark rectangular glasses geometry consistent (and lens transparency rule explicitly locked).
4. Neatly trimmed black jawline beard + upward-curled handlebar moustache never detaches during wide vowels.
5. Olive-green suit lapel notch, two-button stance, slim trouser line, and brown Welt shoes match canonical palette.
6. White shirt collar + navy diagonal red-orange/cream striped tie + navy pocket square stay crisp without z-fighting.
7. Brown leather belt and left-wrist brown-strap watch present whenever wrist/waist is visible.
8. Zero photorealistic skin pores/hair noise or flat 2D outline artifacts.
9. All 10 facial expressions remain readable behind glasses and beard from 3/4 and front angles.
10. Arms-crossed and chin-rest poses have zero sleeve/chin/lapel intersection.
11. Narration lip-sync matches dynamic 140-170 WPM speech without jaw-popping.
12. Engine cutaways remain unobstructed when presenter shares frame.
